Could a more pessimistic AI model be a better one? 

This week on Mixture of Experts, host David Zax is joined by Mihai Criveti, Skyler Speakman and Martin Keen.

First, Jensen Huang is back at NVIDIA after less than two weeks away. The panel looks beyond the chips to what makes NVIDIA’s developer ecosystem so valuable. As Mihai puts it, why not give away the recipe if you’re selling the oven?

Next, Microsoft introduces licensed weight models, offering a middle ground between open and closed models. Martin explains why making an AI model better at one thing could make it worse at others.

Finally, new research out of Oxford suggests AI models have a bleaker outlook on the world than humans do. The findings raise a bigger philosophical question: how much should we want AI to think like us?

All that and more on Mixture of Experts.
